4. In the writ petition, it was stated, inter alia, that the disputed land was gifted in favour of writ-petitioner's father, Hazrat Moulana Peer Abdul Jabbar by the partners of M/S. Matin Firms and Industries by three registered deeds of gift, Hazrat Moulana Peer Abdul Jabbar established Madina Poultry and Dairy and Fisheries Limited (hereinafter referred to as the Company) in a part of the disputed land and he became the Chairman of the Company. The writ petitioner's son became the Director of the Company. Subsequently, the Company was converted into Alba (Agro) Limited Company. The writ-petitioner being a spiritual leader and Secretary of Anjuman-E-Ittihad in the Tarikat Education and Research Division and Chairman of Allama Shah Abdul Jabbar Foundation receives profits and money from the Company. He distributes and spends the money for the charitable purpose through Allama Shah Abdul Jabbar Foundation and Anjuman-E-Ittihad. After the death of Hazrat Moulana Peer Abdul Jabbar on 25.03.1998, his wife, two sons and five daughters inherited the disputed land including his others movable and immovable properties. The other heirs of late Hazrat Moulana Peer Abdul Jabbar executed a power of attorney in favour of the writ - petitioner to file any case, swear affidavits and to do other acts on their behalf in respect of the disputed land. Moulana Kutub Uddin the present peer of Baitus Sharf, has been grabbing the disputed land of Anjuman-E-Ittihad gradually by selling portions thereof in collaboration with some interest persons. The impugned Memo was issued by the Ministry of Land for taking rents of the dispute land from the representative of Anjuman-E-lttihad Bangladesh Baitus Sharf illegally, at the instance of its representative Niranjan Das: hence the writ petitioner was compelled to file the writ petition. 

 6. The writ-petitioner by filing a supplementary affidavit stated that the disputed land was gifted to his father for use of religious and charitable purpose by three registered deeds and accordingly, B.S. Khatian was prepared in his name; the Ministry concerned passed an executive order directing the lower authority to mutate the land and receive rents from writ-respondent No.6 through its representative, Niranjan Das and such order could not be passed without correction of B.S. Khatian through a competent civil court. 

 10. We have looked into the provisions of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 (the Act, 1950). We have found no provision therein which authorised the Ministry/the Government through any Ministry to direct the Revenue Officer to accept rent from a particular person. From the impugned judgment, it appears that the High Court Division failed to give its attention to this legal aspect of the case. Procedures as to the maintenance and revisions of the record of rights have been laid down in Chapter XVII of the Act, 1950 and the Rules framed thereunder vide State Acquisition Rules, 1955 and as per the provisions incorporated therein, one has to apply to the concerned Revenue Officer for mutation of his/its name and if such prayer is allowed then and then only the question of accepting rent from that person would arise, but in the instant case, it does not appear that writ-respondent No.6 or anyone on its behalf ever filed any application to the concerned authority for mutation of its name or record its name in the record of rights and accept rent. Therefore, the impugned Memo issued by the Ministry of Land was passed without any sanction of law and as such, the same cannot be sustained. However, we are of the view that writ respondent No.6 if so advised, may file proper application before the appropriate authority to mutate or record its name and if such application is filed, the concerned authority shall consider the same in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Act, 1950 and the rules of the State Acquisition Rules, 1955 and any party including the writ-petitioners shall have the opportunity to raise legal objection, if any, and the concerned authority shall decide the matter on the basis of the materials produced before it,
